title: Bishop — complete skill frame set
source: maplestory.io, GMS version 270 (skillbook API for jobs 1st–4th; WZ API for 5th/6th job skills and HEXA cores)

skills.name: Magic Guard
skills.description: A portion of the damage dealt to you affects your MP instead of your HP. Does not apply to attacks that inflict damage in proportion to your Max HP.\nActivates when you have 1 or more MP. Does not activate if you have 0 MP.

skills.name: MP Boost
skills.description: Increase Max MP and Attack Speed. Also increases MP proportional to your level.

skills.name: Elemental Weakness
skills.description: Your attacks make enemies vulnerable to Magic attacks, increasing all magical damage while they are debuffed.

skills.name: Magic Armor
skills.description: Uses magic to increase DEF.

skills.name: Energy Bolt
skills.description: Fire a condensed energy bolt that explodes on contact with an enemy.

skills.name: Teleport
skills.description: Allows you to teleport to other locations on the same map using the arrow keys. Permanently increases your Speed and Max Speed.

skills.name: Mana Wave
skills.description: Expel a blast of mana that propels you upwards. This skill is automatically triggered when you press the Jump key while holding the Up Arrow key. If you press the Jump key again and hold, you will slow your descent for a short period.

skills.name: Mana Wave
skills.description: Expel a blast of mana that propels you upwards. This skill is automatically triggered when you press the Jump key while holding the Up Arrow key. If you continue holding the Jump key, you will slow your descent for a short period.

skills.name: MP  Eater
skills.description: Absorb the enemy's MP when attacking with Magic skills. Absorption efficiency is reduced against bosses, resulting in less MP gained.

skills.name: Invincible
skills.description: Decreases all damage taken.

skills.name: Spell Mastery
skills.description: Increases Magic Mastery and Magic ATT.

skills.name: High Wisdom
skills.description: Permanently increase INT through mental discipline.

skills.name: Blessed Ensemble
skills.description: Blessings increase your Final Damage. Obtains additional Party Bonus EXP based on the number of Clerics, Priests, Bishops in the party. Bonus cannot be greater than 60% and does not apply if the level difference is too big between party members. Your own effects do not apply to you.

skills.name: Agile Magic
skills.description: Increases Attack Speed and Intelligence.

skills.name: Heal
skills.description: [Benevolence] Restores the HP of all surrounding party members, including yourself, and reduces Heal's cooldown by the number of people in your party. Undead enemies within the skill range take additional damage.

skills.name: Bless
skills.description: Increases the Attack Power, Magic ATT, and Defense of you and nearby party members for a set amount of time. Can be stacked with all other buff skills.

skills.name: Holy Arrow
skills.description: Attacks multiple monsters with Holy Arrows.  Very effective against Undead and Devil monsters.

skills.name: Angelic Wrath
skills.description: [Vengeance] Calls down an avenging angel to strike the enemy. Enemies struck will be weakened and their Defense will be reduced for a short time.

skills.name: Holy Focus
skills.description: Permanently increases all magic attacks, Heal magic Critical Rates, and Magic Mastery.

skills.name: Magic Critical
skills.description: Permanently increases Critical Rate and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Holy Magic Shell
skills.description: Holy Magic Shell has been activated and cannot be reactivated for a short period of time.

skills.name: Teleport Boost
skills.description: Enhances maneuverability by boosting the range of Teleport.

skills.name: Dispel
skills.description: [Benevolence] Nullifies all enemy magic effects within the targeted area, while removing some abnormal conditions suffered by nearby allies. Decreases Dispel and Divine Protection's cooldown. The Dispel skill can remove critical abnormal conditions, including Stun, Seduction, Confusion, and Zombified.\nSkill effect transparency of Abnormal Status effect applied to party members On/Off: Right-click

skills.name: Mystic Door
skills.description: Creates a portal that leads to the nearest town. All members of the party can use it multiple times until the portal disappears. Press the Up key to move.

skills.name: Holy Symbol
skills.description: Temporarily allows all nearby party members to gain additional EXP while hunting. However, if you go outside of the vicinity of the character that cast Holy Symbol, the efficiency will be reduced by half.

skills.name: Shining Ray
skills.description: Attack multiple enemies at once with a ray of holy light. Deals massive damage to Undead and Devil-type monsters.

skills.name: Teleport Mastery
skills.description: When activated, the skill consumes extra MP, and enemies at the teleport destination will take damage and become Stunned. Permanently increases Knockback Resistance.\nCan be toggled On/Off.#

skills.name: Holy Magic Shell
skills.description: Restores a certain percentage of HP for you and all party members, while also creating a holy shield that defends against all damage for a short time. The shield is not affected by buff duration extension effects. After being activated, it cannot be reactivated for a short time, even if Holy Magic Shell is cast again.

skills.name: Holy Fountain
skills.description: [Benevolence] Summon a Holy Fountain that restores party members' HP. Even party members with the Undead status can use it. Approach the fountain and press the up arrow key to heal.#\nCan't be used on a map where another party member's Holy Fountain, Decent Holy Fountain, or Vestige of Divinity already exists.#\nNot affected by effects which reset cooldowns, increase recovery skill potency, or increase summon duration. Cannot be summoned near a portal.

skills.name: Divine Protection
skills.description: Permanently increases Status Resistance and Elemental Resistance. When used, you create a holy barrier that blocks debilitating status conditions. Applies cooldown after successfully blocking a certain number of conditions. Upon casting Dispel, the cooldown is reduced according to the number of recovered party members.

skills.name: Fountain of Vengeance
skills.description: [Vengeance] Summon a divine talisman of vengeance that punishes nearby enemies. The talisman erupts with light at regular intervals, damaging the enemy.

skills.name: Triumph Feather
skills.description: [Vengeance] Harness the power of the Angel of Victory. While active, when your skills strike an enemy, angel feathers appear and seek out and attack nearby enemies.

skills.name: Triumph Feather
skills.description: Summon angel feathers that seek out and attack nearby enemies.

skills.name: Infinity
skills.description: Bolsters the spirit to enhance your magic and recover HP and MP.

skills.name: Arcane Aim
skills.description: Ignores a portion of enemy Defense when attacking. Damage dealt increases with consecutive attacks. Stacks up to 5 times.

skills.name: Buff Mastery
skills.description: Permanently increases Magic Attack and Final Damage and increases the duration of all buffs on you.\nAlso permanently increases Knockback Resistance.

skills.name: Blessed Harmony
skills.description: Increases the effect of Blessed Ensemble. Blessed Harmony overwrites the effect of Blessed Ensemble.

skills.name: Holy Magic Shell - Extra Guard
skills.description: Increases Holy Magic Shell's guard count.

skills.name: Holy Magic Shell - Persist
skills.description: Increases the duration of Holy Magic Shell.

skills.name: Holy Magic Shell - Enhance
skills.description: Increases Holy Magic Shell's damage reduction rate by a ratio of your max HP.

skills.name: Holy Symbol - Experience
skills.description: Increases your EXP earned when using Holy Symbol.

skills.name: Holy Symbol - Preparation
skills.description: Increases resistance to status ailments and all elements from using Holy Symbol. However, if you go outside of the vicinity of the character that cast Holy Symbol, the efficiency will be reduced by half. Also permanently increases resistance to all ailments and elements.

skills.name: Holy Symbol - Item Drop
skills.description: Increases the drop rate when using Holy Symbol. However, if you go outside of the vicinity of the character that cast Holy Symbol, the efficiency will be reduced by half.

skills.name: Advanced Blessing - Ferocity
skills.description: Increases the effectiveness of Advanced Blessing's Attack Power and Magic ATT boost.

skills.name: Advanced Blessing - Boss Rush
skills.description: Damage increases when attacking Boss Monsters upon use of Advanced Blessing.

skills.name: Advanced Blessing - Extra Point
skills.description: Increases the effectiveness of Advanced Blessing's Max HP and the Max MP boost.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: The Goddess of Maple World's grace increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Maple World appear.

skills.name: Big Bang
skills.description: Holy power spreads out, culminating in a holy explosion.

skills.name: Bahamut
skills.description: Temporarily summons Bahamut to deal Holy damage. Bahamut is unaffected by enemy damage reflection skills.

skills.name: Advanced Blessing
skills.description: Greatly increases nearby party member Attack Power, Magic ATT, DEF, Max HP, and Max MP. Reduces MP consumption upon using the skill. Can be stacked with other buff skills, excluding Bless.

skills.name: Resurrection
skills.description: Use a ray of holy light to resurrect a party member. Resurrected party members have brief invincibility, which cannot be extended by buffs.\nNot affected by cooldown reset.

skills.name: Angel Ray
skills.description: Attack with a holy sword, dealing tremendous holy damage. The holy sword targets the enemy with the highest Max HP. Especially effective against Undead or Devil monsters. Restores party members' HP. Restores Undead party members as well.

skills.name: Genesis
skills.description: A holy ray of light shines down from the sky, dealing tremendous holy damage.

skills.name: Hero's Will
skills.description: Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.\nCan be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Holy Water
skills.description: [Benevolence] Striking enemies with Angel Ray grants you holy water made from their purified blood. On use, summons a chalice of holy water nearby. Party members can press the Up Arrow key while standing on top of the grail to absorb its power and recover HP.

skills.name: Blood of the Divine
skills.description: [Vengeance] Enhance your power by conjuring a spell with your own hallowed blood. Use the skill again to deactivate its effect.

skills.name: Heaven's Door
skills.description: Knocks on the door to the heavens to punish enemies and bless your party members at the same time.\nParty members that receive the Heaven's Door effect cannot receive it again for a short time.

skills.name: Epic Adventure
skills.description: Call upon the bravery deep within to increase damage output.

skills.name: Righteously Indignant
skills.description: Fuel your body with the fury of an avenging angel. Converts Benevolence skills to Vengeance skills.

skills.name: Heaven's Door
skills.description: Knocks on the door to the heavens to punish enemies and bless your party members at the same time.\nNot affected by Cooldown reset.

skills.name: Mana Overload
skills.description: Increases your attack skills by overloading the mana flowing through you.\nRight-click to lock activation effect.#

skills.name: HEXA Angel Ray
skills.description: Attacks with a holy sword, dealing tremendous holy damage. The holy sword targets the enemy with the highest Max HP. It attacks enemies and restores the HP of party members in its path. It can also cure party members with the Undead status.\nWhen the holy sword hits a certain number of times, the angel of judgment is summoned by its holy power and unleashes an additional attack on the enemy. The angel of judgment is only summoned if there are enemies within range. It's a holy-attribute attack.

skills.name: HEXA Big Bang
skills.description:
Holy power spreads out, culminating in a holy explosion. The holy power drastically increases in intervals, allowing you to create a powerful Holy Explosion across a larger area.
Big Bang and the Holy Explosion are Holy attacks.
With Action Customization enabled, Holy Explosions can only be triggered by holding the Up key while casting the skill.
Right-click to toggle Action Customization On/Off

notes: Frames listed with placeholder=true are 1x1 timing placeholders in the source WZ data; the player skips them.

Skill/214.img and Skill/224.img are the 6th-job (HEXA) skill files for F/P and I/L respectively — not Hyper files. Their skillbook endpoints failed (214: hangs / 16-byte error responses after 4 attempts; 224: HTTP 400 "Unknown ExtendedProperty type Canvas#Video"), so those skills were pulled frame-by-frame from the raw WZ API. Skill/234.img (Bishop HEXA) came from its skillbook, which succeeded after retries; the WZ pull for 234 is kept only as a supplement for the effect0 layers the skillbook JSON drops, and is deduplicated by skill ID.

5th-job (Skill/40002.img) effect/hit frames are largely not retrievable from maplestory.io in GMS 270: the effect/hit nodes list frames, but GETs for frames past index 0 hang (>55 s, no response) or return "Nothing was found", and the job 40002 skillbook endpoint returns HTTP 502/524. V skills are included with icons, descriptions and whatever placeholder frame(s) resolved; the unretrievable frames are recorded per skill (status PARTIAL) and in the manifest missing list.
Job 200 (Intro to Magic) skills are shared by all three Magician classes and are included in each class folder.

Mind Delve / Unreliable Memory (shared Magician 5th-job skills) have no entries in Skill/40002.img in GMS 270 and are not included; Maple World Goddess's Blessing (400001042, Skill/40000.img) is a shared skill and is not included, matching the Hero scope.
Ice Age was removed from the game (per maplestorywiki) and has no entry in Skill/40002.img; the current I/L 5th-job set is Frost Ark, Bolt Barrage, Spirit of Snow, Jupiter Thunder.
Bishop HEXA origin skills pulled from Skill/234.img: Holy Advent (2341500-2341506) and Commandment of Heaven (2341507-2341508).
